sql: select * from (select 'event' as kind, created_at as ts, level || ' ' || component || ': ' || left(message, 160) as detail from system_events where created_at >= now() - interval '20 minutes' union all select 'trades/min' as kind, date_trunc('minute', created_at) as ts, count(*)::text || ' trades, ' || count(distinct strategy)::text || ' books' as detail from paper_trades where created_at >= now() - interval '30 minutes' group by date_trunc('minute', created_at) union all select 'bot_run' as kind, coalesce(started_at, created_at) as ts, left(coalesce(status,'') || ' ' || coalesce(mode,'') || ' ' || coalesce(notes,''), 160) as detail from bot_runs where coalesce(started_at, created_at) >= now() - interval '30 minutes') x order by ts desc
